_comment: Steward defaults (P2-187). You override single values in ~/.wk/steward.json (mode, week.anchor, week.weeklyUsd, call.model ...). The self-tuning moves only the knobs under tuning.knobs, always inside these bounds, one change at a time. The pace numbers come from the owner's answer to Q90 (11 Nov 2026): aim for 90 to 100% of the week used at the Monday 06:00 reset, the owner's own use included; keep 20 points free for the owner's tabs until the last 24 hours, then release them. So ceiling 0.80 (1 minus the 20-point reserve), lastHours 24 (the reserve is released for the last 24 hours), landTo 0.98 (inside the band, a sliver left for the owner's last-hour tabs).

maintenance._comment: P2-273: Watchkeeper's own upkeep (steward visits to the projects listed here or inside the plugin folder, and the steward's meter probe) may use at most maxWeekShare of the week; over it the steward skips those projects. items are ledger item names or prefixes.

lenses.finish: what is unfinished, half-done or stalled, and the smallest step that closes it
lenses.features: one feature a real user of this project would miss, from the goal and the audience
lenses.fixes: what is broken, flaky, untested or confusing; use the counts in FACTS
lenses.content: text, pages, help or stories that are missing or weak, and who would read them
lenses.growth: one honest way more of the right people find and keep using it
lenses.outreach: who could use this and how to reach them politely and lawfully (drafts only)
lenses.competitors: what comparable things do better, and one thing to match or beat
lenses.money: how it could earn or save money without hurting trust (proposals only)
lenses.risk: what could hurt it: security, privacy, law, dependency, single point of failure
lenses.delight: a small thing that would make a user smile or tell a friend
